summary: Suggest a hand-shaped object through soft mass transitions and a few intentional surface irregularities.
objective: A close view reveals deliberate sculpting cues rather than generic smooth blobs; adjacent clay-colored parts remain separable.
intent_signals: Show soft sculpted masses and deliberate imperfections
example_prompts: Create a clay-like friendly creature with pressed-in features and distinct articulated limbs.

principles: Suggest a hand-shaped object through soft mass transitions and a few intentional surface irregularities.
implementation: Use rounded joins, slightly uneven rims and broad sculpted indentations; decide which seams are construction features.
Choose subdued highlights and an earthy or invented palette under a large soft key; retain enough value contrast between touching forms.
Use a close three-quarter inspection view; slow squash or joint motion may fit fictional figures, while technical assemblies keep their model constraints.
Round every silhouette edge with a 2-4 mm bevel and offset touching forms by 1-3 mm so adjacent clay parts still separate at a 1 m view.
Author 3-5 thumb indentations per hero form at 6-12 mm depth and keep any surface noise under 0.5 mm amplitude, so the irregularity reads as handling rather than displacement.
observable_checks: A close view reveals deliberate sculpting cues rather than generic smooth blobs; adjacent clay-colored parts remain separable.

known_limits: Values are authored starting points tuned for ACESFilmic tone mapping at renderer.toneMappingExposure 1.0; re-tune intensities and fog density under a different tone mapping or exposure.
No renderer run for this record; values are authored starting points.
creative_affordances: Combine with toy-miniature proportions or stop-motion-inspired timing; visual clay does not imply a deformable physical model.

defaults.rationale: Clay is recognised by how light rolls across a mass, so the key is wide and soft with a 6-8 degree shadow softness at a shallow 2.6:1 ratio - a hard key reads as moulded plastic instead of pressed clay. Roughness is held at 0.55-0.75 (burnished focal form to matte surroundings) and a small transmission of 0.05 at 10 mm thickness gives thin rims the faint warm bleed that separates clay from painted foam.

values.value_structure: 30/50/20 dark/mid/light; contact shadows supply the darks
values.saturation_rule: clay bodies 35-55% saturation; the one glazed accent up to 65%

lights.ratio: key:fill ~ 2.6:1 with a wide soft key; hard-edged shadows read as plastic, not clay

values.intensity_unit: three-intensity (lux-scaled for Directional/Hemisphere, candela for Point/Spot; tuned with the stated tone_mapping.exposure)

materials.notes: 0.55 on the burnished focal form and 0.75 elsewhere; subtle subsurface note - transmission 0.05, thickness 0.01 m, subsurface tint #e8a07a so thin rims bleed warm

motion.ease: sine in-out with a soft settle

values.signature_technique: a wide 52 degree key with 6-8 degree shadow softness plus a faint warm subsurface bleed on thin rims, so mass transitions roll instead of breaking
